name: fleet-engineering
description: Agent-first development methodology for teams, where several people and their agents work parallel branches without corrupting each other's code or docs. Removes every single-writer assumption: ticket IDs instead of sequential numbering, generated indexes and dashboards instead of hand-edited ones, a docs-first PR to main whose machine-readable Claims section acts as the coordination lock, and an adversarial evaluator that must PASS before a code PR opens. Ships the evaluator as a ready-to-use subagent plus the document and infrastructure templates (product spec, design doc, execution plan, tech debt, quality area, docs linter, CODEOWNERS, CI workflow) plus a .NET stack guide.
